verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Statsig serves an official llms.txt at docs.statsig.com (HTTP 200, 'Official documentation for Statsig...'). Several entries indexed from it carry agent-readable page summaries covering checkGate, experiments, dynamic configs and Autotune, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the /.md probe returned 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-oriented corpus, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
